an3.103:1.1: 104 pubbeva me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
an3.103:1.2: ko nu kho loke assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
an3.103:1.4: yaṃ kho loke paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ loke assādo
an3.103:1.5: yaṃ loko anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo ayaṃ loke ādīnavo
an3.103:1.6: yo loke chandarāgapaṭivinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ loke nissaraṇanti.
an3.103:1.7: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.103:1.8: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an3.103:1.10: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
